tactics.label: hidden_ad
tactics.evidence: use the code "thebrilliantbeauty" to get 12% off your order!
tactics.reason: The code 'thebrilliantbeauty' pays the creator every time you buy, and the video never says so.

tactics.label: body_image_pressure
tactics.reason: The title promises results in 14 days, pushing the idea that quick fixes can change your body.

reality_check: This video has been online for 4181 days, yet it still pushes a quick fix. It is built to make you feel like you need to act fast for results. If it got to you, that is the video working, not something wrong with you.
